notes.title: Devlog #12: Secrets of the Sand – May 13th, 2025
notes.content:
Hi, Gamers! 

Tina here—Social Media Expert and Host at RolldBox Games. Today, I’m chatting with Cris, the Art Director of the studio at RolldBox Games 👋


We love sharing and breaking down how we created [i][b]Masks of the Void[/b][/i] for you!

This fast-paced roguelite is all about power—different abilities you’ll unlock, and the real challenge: how far are you willing to push them?

We can’t wait for you to experience the full version soon!
In the meantime, we’ll keep dropping more behind-the-scenes details 😉


[h2][b]Inside the Development Process[/b][/h2]

We’ve been talking about enemies for a while, and in our latest devlog we introduced Ranged—one of the Sand Guards you’ll have to face.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/5f2a174202f19929cb7becc2ccff0c37afdab070.gif[/img]

These creatures were created by the Tyrant to defend and protect its domain.

You’ve already seen a few types… but trust us, there’s more to come.


[b]Today we’re showcasing some very special ones[/b]—emerging straight from the sand: the [i]Elemental Sand Guards[/i].

At first glance, they might look fragile, like they could vanish in a flash…

[b]Are you sure about that?[/b]

Jump into the action and see how fast they move—then let us know if dodging them was really that easy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/3ac340a0140de81536cd75f7185c3ba0e2921ab3.png[/img]

And we can’t forget about our beloved [b]Chasers![/b]

Find out when they show up and what they do while you’re playing—then tell us what kind of impact these desert creatures had on you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/a9d53c12a55895aeb4449497689c8390fcc83cd0.png[/img]


[b][h2]Sneak Peek of Upcoming Content[/h2][/b]


In the [b][i]Sand[/i] world[/b], it’s time to learn a bit more about the [b]Sand Mask[/b].

With it, you can levitate all nearby objects and, after [b]1 second[/b], launch them at your target.

These objects might break on impact—causing a blast of debris all around.

🔹 Check out this awesome [b]poster[/b] our Art Team made to make it shine!

What do you think?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/52004e3aec37d50b6c02b3e593b2c76368ca7942.png[/img]


[b][h2]More to share[/h2][/b]

Speaking of [b]masks[/b]—don’t forget the [b]Blood Mask[/b] is also available in the demo, and you can try it out right now!

We’ll be sharing more about it in our next post.



See you in the next Devlog with more and better!

Don’t forget to [url=https://discord.com/invite/hyQ5p3qNwe]join our Discord server[/url]! Let us know what you’d like us to talk about next from there!

[b]
See you in the Void![/b]

notes.title: Devlog #9: Iret Uncovered– April 1st, 2025
notes.content:
Hi, Gamers! 

Tina here—Social Media Expert and Host at RolldBox Games. Today, I’m chatting with Cris, the Art Director of the studio at RolldBox Games 👋

We love crafting these experiences with you in mind, aiming to make them as immersive as possible. Today, we’re diving deeper into the details behind our refined art. There are so many layers—literally! Here’s more about our protagonist, Iret, in this DevLog.

[h2][b]Inside the Development Process[/b][/h2]

As mentioned in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2542350/view/825952834335803040]Devlog #8[/url], Iret’s layers were meticulously designed to deliver the smooth, dynamic movement we envisioned. We defined and added plenty of bones to maximize flexibility and adaptability. You can see the result in this side-scrolling scene of Iret.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/10c1437372dee1d8728b3832aa616bd8cc46b48b.gif[/img]

On top of that, our [b]Technical Artist[/b] has taken the layer effects to the next level. We didn’t stop until every linked mask projected its corresponding effect onto the layer—crisp, powerful, and crystal clear.

What was the biggest challenge? Translating the concept art—with the exact color palette for each mask and outfit—into a final in-game effect that looks just right. This meant considering the camera’s perspective, the chaos of combat, and the overall game flow.

🔹 [b]Here’s the Concept Art:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/69e2d5611ee95160b4d3ee19ba7389d41ec5b3a5.png[/img]

🔹 Here’s the layer effect with the [b]Sand Mask[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/992af63b56a00aae9aefc8098b9160b959c5f4a3.gif[/img]

🔹 And here’s the layer effect with the [b]Blood Mask[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/4c1a8a5ac32282aef89a972a7c610f99fb503913.gif[/img]

[b][h2]Sneak Peek of Upcoming Content[/h2][/b]

Let’s talk about Iret’s interactions with [b]NPCs, bosses, and enemies[/b]. Guess how many [b]AIs[/b] we’ve set up? Over 50 unique configurations to ensure a diverse gameplay experience!

In the meantime, here’s something cool: the first AIs we created were the [b]Soldier and Dasher[/b], which you can check out in the image:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/73ff297eaa201116ffa5b133f3452509e8c81217.gif[/img]

[b][h2]More to share[/h2][/b]

[b]Remember how to unlock the second Mask in the Demo?[/b]

At the end of the demo, once you've completed that section of the game, you can unlock the second mask – the [b]‘Blood’ Mask[/b]. Have you figured out how it works yet?

Each mask unlocks a new way to use telekinesis.

Which one do you think is the most fun to use?



See you in the next Devlog with more and better!

Don’t forget to [url=https://discord.com/invite/hyQ5p3qNwe]join our Discord server[/url]! Let us know what you’d like us to talk about next from there!

[b]
See you in the Void![/b]

notes.title: Devlog #8: Art From the Inside – March 18th, 2025
notes.content:
Hi, Gamers! 

Tina here—Social Media Expert and Host at RolldBox Games. Today, I’m chatting with Cris, the Art Director of the studio at RolldBox Games 👋

The art in a video game is insanely complex, and we have to consider many aspects to make sure it hits the mark on the[b] story[/b] we want to tell, the [b]game feeling[/b] we want to create, and that it fully matches the intended [b]gameplay[/b]. Today, we’re pulling back the curtain to give you a closer look at the details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/65e3ff9d44ab430c3cf3120a94edd531912ed7ee.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Inside the Development Process[/b][/h2]

As we mentioned in [i]Devlog #7[/i], we covered the throwable objects. Today, we’re diving into how we make them both “breakable” and “throwable”:

To give all [b]throwable objects[/b] a realistic feel, placing their pivot point at the center of mass is crucial, considering their shape to figure out where the weight naturally balances. [i]Blender[/i] came in clutch here, as it has a built-in feature to set the pivot point at the center of mass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/0ebe52bd4155dfae3e01985a891d3c284cdcb6c1.png[/img]

For [b]breakable and throwable props[/b], making sure the pivot is as centered as possible was essential. While using [i]Unreal[/i]’s destruction system, the generated pieces would keep their pivot in the center. [b]But not all objects used Unreal’s system—we crafted the pieces by hand[/b], like bones, to make sure the way they broke into parts made sense.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/18685cefd71f10b7e7bfb1c1e8db7f04fecf8399.png[/img]

[b][h2]Sneak Peek of Upcoming Content[/h2][/b]

Iret's capes, the design, creation, and animation process, have evolved several times. Here’s how we animated them:

We’re all about showing that they have a lot of bones because we want their movement to be superfluid, and that meant animating the capes by hand for each animation, which took a lot of time. To optimize it, [b]we decided to use [i]Unreal[/i]’s physics system for most animations, allowing them to move more organically with Iret’s body[/b]. For some specific animations, like the basic and special attacks with the different masks, where we needed the capes to have more complex movements, we spent extra time hand-animating them to get the exact movement we wanted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/5be9f07c106d8d374066ec54ea1c5ccf3ee11f31.gif[/img]


[b][h2]More to share[/h2][/b]

Don’t forget to dive into the story or the Infinite Waves and discover the different types of relics!
Want to know the secret to survive longer? Grab and combine relics of the same theme to unlock powerful synergies! ⚙️

Think you’re ready to take it on?


See you in the next Devlog with more and better!

Don’t forget to [url=https://discord.com/invite/hyQ5p3qNwe]join our Discord server[/url]! Let us know what you’d like us to talk about next from there!

[b]
See you in the Void![/b]

notes.title: Devlog #3: The Challenges of Creating the Void – January 9th, 2025
notes.content:
Hi, Gamers!

Tina here—Social Media Expert and Host at RolldBox Games. Today, I’m chatting with Ferran, one of our Co-Founders, as well as the Game Designer and Creative Director of the studio at RolldBox Games 👋

We hope you had an amazing time this holiday season with the DEMO of [b][i]Masks of the Void[/i][/b]. In fact, we’ve got a really exciting milestone right now:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/8be28e5e0a86c7fd90038537a2542349d21b59f9.png[/img]

Are you ready to take them on?

[h2][b]Inside the Development Process[/b][/h2]

We gave you a sneak peek at some Void creatures in the previous blog. What do you think? Now, let’s share a cool detail about their behavior.

While developing the AI for this Void creature, one of the toughest challenges our programming team faced was the mechanic of attacking from below the ground. We had to make sure multiple animations didn't interrupt at key moments, like when it emerges from the ground to strike.

The Void is a world like no other. It has power and influence over every other universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/c08c99cfd06173ead62d7111d6edeee6f1d72d5e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/c013b30a0c425d19858640dd0299a7d25b312747.png[/img]


[b][h2]Sneak Peek of Upcoming Content[/h2][/b]

How do you imagine the Void Architecture? Given the powerful feeling of exploring the entire Void world, we had a particular vision of the Gothic world in mind.

The transition from concept to modeling was key to properly scaling each element within the overall context. You’ll get the full experience in the product’s full version!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/77cf126864c16739c1857b16f6467ee06d601b21.png[/img]

[b][h2]More to share[/h2][/b]

At the end of the demo, once you've completed that part of the game, you can unlock a second mask – the 'Blood' mask. Have you figured out how it works yet?

Each mask unlocks a different way to use telekinesis.

Which one do you like the most?



See you in the next Devlog with more and better!

Don’t forget to [url=https://discord.com/invite/hyQ5p3qNwe]join our Discord server[/url]! Let us know what you’d like us to talk about next from there!

[b]
See you in the Void![/b]

notes.title: Devlog #1: What we do with Masks of the Void – December 20th, 2024
notes.content:
Hi, Gamers!

Tina here—Social Media Expert and Host at RolldBox Games. Today, I’m chatting with Ferran, one of our Co-Founders, as well as the Game Designer and Creative Director of the studio. 👋

After working on this project for a long time and with the release of the DEMO, we’re excited to share what’s being done to bring the development process to completion. We’ll keep sharing tidbits with you so you can get a sneak peek behind the scenes. Let’s get started!
That’s why we’re thrilled to share insights into the production of [b][i]Masks of the Void[/i][/b], from the unique perspectives of our team members.

[h2][b]Inside the Development Process[/b][/h2]

As we progress in the development of [b][i]Masks of the Void[/i][/b], we’ve been working on several features and want to create a space for you to catch a glimpse of what’s in the works and how it’s evolving.
One thing we were excited to share, for example, is the evolution of the UI and how it has changed over time through playtesting. Among all the UI elements, the upgrades screen stands out—the one that allows IRET to develop its power during a run. This UI has undergone several changes, as we’ve been simplifying and refining it over time, such as:

[b]1st Iteration[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/0f7eb9df109dced6019bb3c7db7060e863551b84.png[/img]

[b]2nd iteration[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/b359690607ae52b40edadeb7b9d311001eedfe40.png[/img]

[b]And now it looks like:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/92aa3684c1ee950d2eeaebb3744ade52dc401924.png[/img]

Developing this UI was a massive effort, trying to balance letting the player know what can be done without overwhelming them with too many buttons. We ended up placing all the options on the same screen, with an unbalanced distribution, to let players know they can develop IRET and also perform some secondary actions with the Energy.



[b][h2]Sneak Peek of Upcoming Content[/h2][/b]

In every Devlog, we will be showing some of the upcoming details of the game as part of the full development of [b][i]Masks of the Void[/i][/b]. For today’s opening blog, we are delighted to share what the Void realm looks like! Have you ever wondered where the Cultists come from?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/c3e61b83f2b2340ad1d8df7529667e906c4a1ebb.png[/img]

[b][h2]More to share[/h2][/b]

In the demo, you can already practice with two masks! 

Reach the end of the story, and you’ll unlock a second one: [b]the Blood mask[/b], where you’ll discover new forms of telekinesis. Give it a try and let us know what you think!

See you in the next Devlog with more and better!

Don’t forget to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/hyQ5p3qNwe]Discord server[/url]! Let us know what you’d like us to talk about next from there!

See you in the Void!
